about_the_game:
The Slightly Overweight Superhero – Demo Version 

Get a sneak peek of the chaos, charm, and chub-powered heroics coming in the full game!
In The Slightly Overweight Superhero Demo, you’ll take control of a determined, slightly out-of-shape hero as you jump, roll, and platform your way through a slice of the game’s diverse environments.

The full game features:

  • 5 engaging worlds

  • Hundreds of unique collectibles

  • 27 secret Golden Tablets hidden behind puzzles, movement challenges, and cryptic ciphers.

🌀 Welcome to the year 2140.
When you die (and trust us, you will), your soul is uploaded to the Cloud — a digital afterlife where you must gather soul fragments to come back to life. But don’t get too comfortable... yes, you can even die in the Cloud. That sends you to the Second Level of Death, where the risks are even higher.

And if you’re unlucky enough to meet Snowy McPatterson, well... he might just banish you to any one of the Seven Levels of Death.

⚡ What’s in the Demo?

The demo gives you a taste of the challenges ahead, including:

  • Sample environments from the full game

  • A preview of the death-and-rebirth mechanic

  • Your first glimpse of the mysterious Cloud realm and the Seven levels of death

"You’re the chubby champion of a future gone wrong — and to survive, you'll need brains, timing, and a surprisingly agile roll. This demo is just a bite-sized glimpse into the madness of a much bigger adventure."

short_description: The year? 2140. The problem? You keep dying. Good news: your soul uploads to the Cloud. Bad news? The Cloud is full of things that want you dead again. This is just the taste test of your chubby superhero saga. Solve riddles, dodge traps, and survive the Seven Levels of Death.
